facts.claim: When the last client releases a chat, its runner ends at once only if its turn is at rest; otherwise the running turn finishes first.
facts.catch_criteria: States both branches of the release: immediate end at rest, and the running turn finishing first.

facts.claim: Attaching seeds and attaches the runner and marks it shown; it never starts or resumes a turn.
facts.catch_criteria: States that attaching a client does not resume the stopped turn.

facts.claim: A turn end detaches the runner as completed or paused; failures and mid-turn kills detach as paused.
facts.catch_criteria: Names the paused detach outcome for an unfinished turn.

facts.claim: A chat whose capacity wait is due is resumed by the account and project wake through a chat.resume mutation, with no check of whether a client shows it.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a due capacity wait is continued automatically even when no client shows the chat.

facts.claim: chat.resume activates and resumes the chat, refusing only when a turn already runs or the last turn end is not resumable.
facts.catch_criteria: Names the not-resumable refusal of the resume path.

facts.claim: A stalled wait resumes only on an explicit resume, unlike a due capacity wait.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a stall is not resumed automatically and needs an explicit resume.

traps.wrong_answer: Nothing restarts the unshown chat: it stays paused until a person sends a message.
Attaching a client tab to the paused chat resumes its turn.
